description: Register an HTTPS endpoint that receives events as signed JSON POSTs and return it with its signing secret, which is shown only this once. Events: message.received (inbound mail, the default), message.delivered, message.bounced, message.complained, message.rejected. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Default ["message.received"].

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive the POSTed events.

name: create_webhook
title: Create webhook
